title: Bounded above acyclic subcomplexes of bounded size inside any acyclic complex
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a cardinal such that every nonzero acyclic complex contains a nonzero bounded above acyclic subcomplex of bounded size, and such that every acyclic complex is a quotient of a coproduct of such subcomplexes (statement lines 1807-1820). The proof is a complete construction: a generator is chosen and the bound is defined by iterating the size function of a named lemma (proof lines 1822-1826); the subcomplex is produced by pushing surjections of bounded size onto the terms along the differential and closing up inside the acyclic complex (proof lines 1827-1840); and iterating over the quotients gives the second assertion (proof lines 1840-1846). The non-formal content is the closing-up argument. The claim is H2.
